display.text:
# Program Design: Connected Apple Calendar

## Files

### Backend and data

- `backend/migrations/0023_caldav_accounts.sql` — create principals,
  credentials, stable event resources, calendar revisions, and change-log
  tombstones with their constraints and indexes.
- `backend/migrations/rollbacks/0023_rollback.sql` — remove only the tables and
  indexes introduced by migration 0023 in dependency-safe order.
- `backend/Cargo.toml` and `backend/Cargo.lock` — add `quick-xml` for bounded DAV
  XML parsing and serialization; reuse the existing UUID and cryptography crates.
- `backend/src/lib.rs` — export the new `caldav` module.
- `backend/src/caldav/mod.rs` — module boundary and shared constants for request,
  report, and serialization limits.
- `backend/src/caldav/types.rs` — protocol-neutral account, credential, resource,
  property, report, sync, and error types.
- `backend/src/caldav/auth.rs` — parse Basic credentials, issue and revoke
  connection passwords, authenticate them in constant time, and update safe
  usage metadata.
- `backend/src/caldav/xml.rs` — bounded namespace-aware parsing of DAV property
  and report bodies plus deterministic `multistatus` and DAV error rendering.
- `backend/src/caldav/ical.rs` — parse and serialize one canonical CalDAV event
  resource, group recurrence exceptions with their master, and preserve only the
  explicitly safe unmodelled properties.
- `backend/src/caldav/repository.rs` — database operations for principals,
  resource identities, resource revisions, calendar revisions, and tombstones;
  all mutation helpers accept the caller's existing SQL transaction.
- `backend/src/caldav/service.rs` — authorize discovery and calendar operations,
  translate reports into repository/domain calls, and translate `PUT`/`DELETE`
  into `EventService` commands.
- `backend/src/caldav/http.rs` — isolated DAV router, method dispatch, headers,
  status codes, body limits, request IDs, and Basic-auth middleware.
- `backend/src/caldav/rate_limit.rs` — separate per-IP authentication limits and
  per-credential write limits for DAV traffic.
- `backend/src/security.rs` — replace the legacy public-feed `Caldav` token label
  with a connection-credential token domain used only for account passwords.
- `backend/src/event.rs` — record resource upserts, moves, recurrence changes,
  and delete tombstones inside the same transaction as every event mutation.
- `backend/src/external_feed.rs` — record imported event upserts/deletions in the
  DAV change log while keeping those resources read-only.
- `backend/src/calendar.rs` — expose the existing ACL result in a form that maps
  cleanly to DAV read/write/free-busy privileges.
- `backend/src/http.rs` — add cookie-authenticated connection-management routes,
  state, and request/response DTOs; remove the misleading public-view CalDAV
  management path and feed route.
- `backend/src/shared_view.rs` — remove dead placeholder CalDAV URL/token logic;
  leave migration 0021 columns untouched for deployment compatibility.
- `backend/src/config.rs` — parse and validate `CALDAV_PUBLIC_ORIGIN`; require an
  HTTPS origin without a path in production.
- `backend/src/main.rs` — construct CalDAV services and rate limiters, then merge
  the DAV router separately from public, browser-session, and MCP routers.

### Frontend

- `frontend/src/settings/calendarConnectionsApi.ts` — typed connection status,
  password creation, individual revocation, and revoke-all requests.
- `frontend/src/settings/CalendarConnections.tsx` — implement disconnected,
  setup-secret, connected, error/attention, and revoke confirmation states.
- `frontend/src/settings/CalendarConnections.css` — responsive styles for the
  approved connection screen.
- `frontend/src/settings/CalendarConnections.test.tsx` — interaction and secret-
  handling tests for every state.
- `frontend/src/App.tsx` — make the existing settings button navigate to
  `/settings/calendar-connections` and mount the connection screen.
- `frontend/src/App.test.tsx` — verify settings navigation and authenticated route
  behavior.
- `frontend/src/calendar/CompositeViewManagement.tsx` — remove the broken
  “Apple Calendar (CalDAV)” public-view toggle and placeholder link.
- `frontend/src/calendar/CompositeViewManagement.test.tsx` — remove obsolete
  public-feed expectations and retain public-view publication coverage.

### Configuration, documentation, and end-to-end proof

- `.env.example` and `deploy/.env.example` — document `CALDAV_PUBLIC_ORIGIN`
  without a value or credential.
- `deploy/values-production.yaml` — pass the public DAV origin to the backend
  deployment using the existing configuration pattern.
- `README.md` — document the connection feature, local DAV URL, supported event
  fields, and deliberate first-release exclusions.
- `e2e/tests/caldav-account.spec.ts` — exercise connection-password issuance,
  discovery, initial read, Apple-style create/update/delete, incremental sync,
  ACL rejection, and revocation over real HTTP.

## Types and signatures

Signatures below define boundaries, not implementation bodies.

### Connection accounts and authentication

```rust
// caldav/types.rs
pub struct CaldavAccount {
    pub user_id: i64,
    pub principal_id: String,
}

pub struct CredentialMetadata {
    pub id: i64,
    pub label: String,
    pub created_at: i64,
    pub last_used_at: Option<i64>,
}

pub struct IssuedCredential {
    pub metadata: CredentialMetadata,
    pub username: String,
    pub password: SecretToken,
    pub server_url: String,
}

pub struct ConnectionStatus {
    pub server_url: String,
    pub principal_id: Option<String>,
    pub credentials: Vec<CredentialMetadata>,
    pub last_successful_access_at: Option<i64>,
}

pub struct DavSession {
    pub user_id: i64,
    pub credential_id: i64,
    pub principal_id: String,
}

pub enum CaldavAuthError {
    InvalidCredentials,
    Revoked,
    RateLimited,
    Persistence,
}
```

```rust
// caldav/auth.rs
pub struct CaldavAccountService { /* private fields */ }

impl CaldavAccountService {
    pub fn new(pool: SqlitePool, key: SecretKey, public_origin: Url) -> Self;

    pub async fn status(
        &self,
        actor_user_id: i64,
    ) -> Result<ConnectionStatus, CaldavAuthError>;

    pub async fn issue_credential(
        &self,
        actor_user_id: i64,
        label: String,
    ) -> Result<IssuedCredential, CaldavAuthError>;

    pub async fn revoke_credential(
        &self,
        actor_user_id: i64,
        credential_id: i64,
    ) -> Result<(), CaldavAuthError>;

    pub async fn revoke_all(
        &self,
        actor_user_id: i64,
    ) -> Result<u64, CaldavAuthError>;

    pub async fn authenticate(
        &self,
        authorization: &HeaderValue,
    ) -> Result<DavSession, CaldavAuthError>;
}
```

### DAV request and response model

```rust
// caldav/types.rs
pub enum DavResourcePath {
    Root,
    Principal { principal_id: String },
    CalendarHome { principal_id: String },
    Calendar { principal_id: String, calendar_key: String },
    Event {
        principal_id: String,
        calendar_key: String,
        resource_name: String,
    },
}

pub enum PropertyRequest {
    Named(Vec<DavPropertyName>),
    AllProp { include: Vec<DavPropertyName> },
    PropName,
}

pub enum ReportRequest {
    CalendarQuery(CalendarQuery),
    CalendarMultiget(CalendarMultiget),
    SyncCollection(SyncCollection),
}

pub struct CalendarQuery {
    pub range: Option<EventRange>,
    pub properties: Vec<DavPropertyName>,
}

pub struct SyncCollection {
    pub token: Option<SyncToken>,
    pub limit: Option<usize>,
    pub properties: Vec<DavPropertyName>,
}

pub struct SyncToken(String);

pub struct DavMultistatus {
    pub responses: Vec<DavResponse>,
    pub sync_token: Option<SyncToken>,
}

pub enum CaldavError {
    BadRequest,
    Unauthorized,
    Forbidden,
    NotFound,
    PreconditionFailed,
    UnsupportedMediaType,
    LimitExceeded,
    InvalidSyncToken,
    Persistence,
}
```

```rust
// caldav/xml.rs
pub fn parse_propfind(
    bytes: &[u8],
    limits: DavXmlLimits,
) -> Result<PropertyRequest, CaldavError>;

pub fn parse_report(
    bytes: &[u8],
    limits: DavXmlLimits,
) -> Result<ReportRequest, CaldavError>;

pub fn render_multistatus(value: &DavMultistatus) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CaldavError>;

pub fn render_dav_error(error: &CaldavError) -> Vec<u8>;
```

### iCalendar resource model

```rust
// caldav/types.rs
pub struct CaldavEventResource {
    pub uid: String,
    pub resource_name: String,
    pub etag: EntityTag,
    pub master: EventMutation,
    pub recurrence_rule: Option<String>,
    pub exceptions: Vec<CaldavRecurrenceException>,
    pub preserved_properties: PreservedProperties,
}

pub enum CaldavRecurrenceException {
    Modified {
        recurrence: RecurrenceKey,
        event: EventMutation,
    },
    Deleted { recurrence: RecurrenceKey },
}

pub struct ParsedCaldavResource {
    pub uid: String,
    pub master: EventMutation,
    pub recurrence_rule: Option<String>,
    pub exceptions: Vec<CaldavRecurrenceException>,
    pub preserved_properties: PreservedProperties,
}

pub struct EntityTag(String);
pub struct PreservedProperties(Vec<PreservedProperty>);
```

```rust
// caldav/ical.rs
pub fn parse_event_resource(
    body: &[u8],
    limits: CaldavIcalLimits,
) -> Result<ParsedCaldavResource, CaldavError>;

pub fn serialize_event_resource(
    resource: &CaldavEventResource,
) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CaldavError>;
```

### Transactional resource and change tracking

```rust
// caldav/repository.rs
pub struct CaldavRepository { /* private fields */ }

impl CaldavRepository {
    pub async fn ensure_resource(
        transaction: &mut Transaction<'_, Sqlite>,
        calendar_id: i64,
        event_id: i64,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<ResourceIdentity, CaldavError>;

    pub async fn record_upsert(
        transaction: &mut Transaction<'_, Sqlite>,
        calendar_id: i64,
        event_id: i64,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<ResourceIdentity, CaldavError>;

    pub async fn record_move(
        transaction: &mut Transaction<'_, Sqlite>,
        source_calendar_id: i64,
        target_calendar_id: i64,
        event_id: i64,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<ResourceIdentity, CaldavError>;

    pub async fn record_delete(
        transaction: &mut Transaction<'_, Sqlite>,
        calendar_id: i64,
        event_id: i64,
        now: i64,
    ) -> Result<(), CaldavError>;

    pub async fn changes_since(
        &self,
        calendar_id: i64,
        token: Option<&SyncToken>,
        limit: usize,
    ) -> Result<ChangePage, CaldavError>;
}
```

`record_upsert`, `record_move`, and `record_delete` are called before the owning
event transaction commits. They are not asynchronous notifications and cannot
fail after the event has already committed.

### CalDAV application service and HTTP boundary

```rust
// caldav/service.rs
pub struct CaldavService { /* private fields */ }

impl CaldavService {
    pub async fn propfind(
        &self,
        session: &DavSession,
        path: DavResourcePath,
        depth: DavDepth,
        request: PropertyRequest,
    ) -> Result<DavMultistatus, CaldavError>;

    pub async fn report(
        &self,
        session: &DavSession,
        path: DavResourcePath,
        request: ReportRequest,
    ) -> Result<DavMultistatus, CaldavError>;

    pub async fn get_event(
        &self,
        session: &DavSession,
        path: DavResourcePath,
    ) -> Result<CaldavEventResource, CaldavError>;

    pub async fn put_event(
        &self,
        session: &DavSession,
        path: DavResourcePath,
        precondition: WritePrecondition,
        resource: ParsedCaldavResource,
    ) -> Result<PutResult, CaldavError>;

    pub async fn delete_event(
        &self,
        session: &DavSession,
        path: DavResourcePath,
        precondition: WritePrecondition,
    ) -> Result<(), CaldavError>;
}
```

```rust
// caldav/http.rs
pub fn build_caldav_router(
    service: CaldavService,
    accounts: CaldavAccountService,
    limiter: Option<CaldavRateLimiter>,
) -> Router;

pub fn build_connection_management_router(
    accounts: CaldavAccountService,
) -> Router<ApplicationState>;
```

### Browser API model

```typescript
// settings/calendarConnectionsApi.ts
export interface CalendarConnectionPassword {
  id: number;
  label: string;
  created_at: number;
  last_used_at: number | null;
}

export interface AppleCalendarConnection {
  server_url: string;
  username: string;
  last_successful_access_at: number | null;
  passwords: CalendarConnectionPassword[];
}

export interface IssuedCalendarPassword {
  password: CalendarConnectionPassword;
  clear_password: string;
  server_url: string;
  username: string;
}

export function getAppleCalendarConnection(
  api: ApiClient,
): Promise<AppleCalendarConnection>;

export function createAppleCalendarPassword(
  api: ApiClient,
  label: string,
): Promise<IssuedCalendarPassword>;

export function revokeAppleCalendarPassword(
  api: ApiClient,
  id: number,
): Promise<void>;

export function disconnectAppleCalendar(api: ApiClient): Promise<void>;
```

## Call stacks

### Generate a connection password

```text
CalendarConnections.generate()
  → createAppleCalendarPassword(api, label)
    → POST /api/v1/calendar-connections/apple/passwords
      → browser session + CSRF middleware
      → CaldavAccountService.issue_credential(user_id, label)
        → fetch-or-create stable principal
        → generate domain-separated secret and store only its hash
      → return clear password once
  → render setup instructions; never persist clear password in browser storage
```

### Discover calendars

```text
Apple Calendar PROPFIND /dav/
  → DAV authentication/rate-limit middleware
    → CaldavAccountService.authenticate(Authorization)
  → parse DavResourcePath + bounded property request
  → CaldavService.propfind(session, Root, depth, properties)
    → return current-user-principal
  → Apple follows principal → calendar-home-set
    → CalendarService lists authorized, non-archived calendars
    → roles map to DAV privileges
  → render 207 Multi-Status
```

### Initial and incremental synchronization

```text
Apple Calendar REPORT calendar-query | sync-collection
  → DAV authentication and path ownership check
  → parse_report(body, limits)
  → CaldavService.report(...)
    → authorize calendar read scope
    → CaldavRepository.ensure_resource(...) for unmapped legacy events
    → query matching resources or CaldavRepository.changes_since(...)
    → serialize requested ETags/calendar-data and tombstones
  → render 207 Multi-Status + opaque next sync token
```

### Create or update from Apple Calendar

```text
Apple Calendar PUT .../:resource_name.ics
  → DAV authentication + per-credential write limiter
  → validate Content-Type, body size, path, If-Match/If-None-Match
  → parse_event_resource(body, limits)
  → CaldavService.put_event(...)
    → authorize existing calendar role
    → resolve resource name + UID and verify precondition
    → EventService.create[_recurring] | update + occurrence commands
      → existing domain validation + audit
      → CaldavRepository.record_upsert(...) in same transaction
      → commit
      → notification replanning
  → 201 or 204 with Location and current ETag
```

### Update from Happening and delete from Apple Calendar

```text
Browser/MCP event mutation
  → EventService mutation transaction
    → CaldavRepository.record_upsert | record_move | record_delete
    → commit → notification replanning
  → next Apple sync-collection report receives change/tombstone

Apple Calendar DELETE .../:resource_name.ics
  → DAV authentication + write authorization + ETag check
  → EventService.delete(...)
    → CaldavRepository.record_delete(...) before event row cascade
    → audit + commit
  → 204; next sync reports tombstone to other devices
```

## Test plan

### Migration and repository tests

- `caldav_migration_enforces_unique_principal_and_resource_identity` — duplicate
  principals, UIDs, or resource names fail without partial rows.
- `credential_rows_never_store_clear_password` — database values contain only
  prefix/hash and safe metadata.
- `record_upsert_is_atomic_with_event_create` — forced change-log failure rolls
  back both event and resource identity.
- `record_delete_keeps_tombstone_after_event_cascade` — deletion remains visible
  after the event/resource mapping is gone.
- `record_move_changes_both_calendar_tokens` — source reports deletion and target
  reports creation under the same stable UID.
- `changes_since_returns_each_resource_final_state_once` — repeated updates are
  coalesced without losing deletions.
- `expired_sync_token_requires_full_resync` — stale tokens never produce an
  incomplete delta.

### Credential and security tests

- `issue_credential_returns_secret_once_and_hashes_at_rest`.
- `authenticate_accepts_email_and_active_connection_password`.
- `authenticate_returns_same_unauthorized_shape_for_all_failures`.
- `revoking_one_credential_does_not_revoke_other_devices`.
- `revoke_all_invalidates_every_connection_password_immediately`.
- `dav_auth_rate_limit_is_independent_of_browser_write_limit`.
- `dav_logs_and_debug_values_redact_authorization_and_event_bodies`.
- `production_rejects_non_https_caldav_public_origin`.

### DAV XML and HTTP contract tests

- `well_known_caldav_redirects_to_dav_root`.

## Least confident decisions

1. **Exact Apple client subset.** The RFC surface is clear, but Apple Calendar may
   make additional property requests or method calls during setup. The tracer
   slice must connect a real client early and promote any observed requirement
   into a regression fixture before the protocol grows further.
2. **Preserved properties.** Round-tripping safe properties prevents data loss,
   but merging opaque client data with Happening edits is subtle. The allowlist
   should start narrow; scheduling properties stay rejected until invitations
   have an explicit product and security design.
3. **Free/busy calendars.** Busy placeholders respect current permissions but may
   be less useful than omitting those calendars entirely. Real-client UX should
   decide this before finalizing the collection projection.

   pruning requires a documented token lifetime and a reliable full-resync path.
   Initial implementation should prefer correctness, then add bounded retention
   only with tests and operational metrics.
5. **Manual account setup.** Server, username, and generated password are robust
   and avoid Apple dependencies, but setup is less polished than OAuth. Automatic
   profile installation is intentionally deferred because it adds signing,
   platform policy, and trust-surface concerns.

    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub is_external: Option<bool>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub read_only: Option<bool>,
}

async fn mark_external_projections(
    pool: &SqlitePool,
    projections: &mut [EventProjection],
) -> Result<(), EventServiceError> {
    for projection in projections {
        let is_external = sqlx::query_scalar::<_, bool>(
            "SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM external_event_mapping WHERE event_id = ?)",
        )
        .bind(projection.id)
        .fetch_one(pool)
        .await?;
        if is_external {
            projection.is_external = Some(true);
            projection.read_only = Some(true);
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn project_event(event: Event, access: EventAccess) -> EventProjection {
    let details = matches!(access, EventAccess::Details);
    let (event_kind, start_utc, end_utc, timezone, start_date, end_date) = match event.timing {
        EventTiming::Timed {
            start_utc,
            end_utc,
            timezone,
        } => (
            "timed",
            Some(start_utc),
            Some(end_utc),
            details.then_some(timezone),
            None,
            None,
        ),
        EventTiming::AllDay {
            start_date,
            end_date,
        } => (
            "all_day",
            None,
            None,
            None,
            Some(start_date),
            Some(end_date),
        ),
    };
    EventProjection {
        id: event.id,
        calendar_id: event.calendar_id,
        access: if details { "details" } else { "free_busy" },
        title: details.then_some(event.title),
        description: if details { event.description } else { None },
        location: if details { event.location } else { None },
        status: event.status.as_str(),
        event_kind,
        start_utc,
        end_utc,
        timezone,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        created_by_user_id: details.then_some(event.created_by_user_id),
        last_edited_by_user_id: details.then_some(event.last_edited_by_user_id),
        version: details.then_some(event.version),
        created_at: details.then_some(event.created_at),
        updated_at: details.then_some(event.updated_at),
        recurrence_rule: None,
        series_id: None,
        recurrence_id: None,
        recurrence_date: None,
        is_external: None,
        read_only: None,
    }
}

570: /// Return the `.ics` resource name listed in a calendar PROPFIND response.
571: fn extract_resource_name(body: &str) -> Option<String> {
572:     for line in body.lines() {
573:         if line.contains("<D:href>") && line.contains(".ics") {
574:             let start = line.find("<D:href>")? + "<D:href>".len();
575:             let href = line[start..].trim_end().strip_suffix("</D:href>")?;
576:             let name = href.rsplit('/').next()?.strip_suffix(".ics")?;
577:             return Some(name.to_owned());
578:         }
579:     }
580:     None
581: }

1134: /// Issue a `PUT` to an existing resource with an `If-Match` precondition.
1135: async fn put_update_request(
1136:     app: Router,
1137:     uri: &str,
1138:     auth: Option<(&str, &str)>,
1139:     body: &str,
1140:     if_match: Option<&str>,
1141: ) -> (StatusCode, HeaderMap, String) {
1142:     let mut builder = Request::builder()
1143:         .method(Method::PUT)
1144:         .uri(uri)
1145:         .header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/calendar; charset=utf-8");
1146:     if let Some((username, password)) = auth {
1147:         builder = builder.header(header::AUTHORIZATION, basic_header(username, password));
1148:     }
1149:     if let Some(value) = if_match {
1150:         builder = builder.header(header::IF_MATCH, value);
1151:     }
1152:     let response = app
1153:         .oneshot(builder.body(Body::from(body.to_owned())).unwrap())
1154:         .await
1155:         .unwrap();
1156:     let status = response.status();
1157:     let headers = response.headers().clone();
1158:     let body = response.into_body().collect().await.unwrap().to_bytes();
1159:     (status, headers, String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).into_owned())
1160: }

117: /// Fold a content line to at most 73 octets per RFC 5545 section 3.1.
118: fn fold_line(line: &str) -> String {

239: /// Only `<D:href>` elements that are direct children of the root are
240: /// captured. The list is bounded by `MAX_MULTIGET_HREFS`.
241: pub fn parse_calendar_multiget(body: &[u8]) -> Result<CalendarMultiget, QueryError> {
242:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
243:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
244:     }
245:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
246:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
247:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
248: 
249:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
250:     let mut root_seen = false;
251:     let mut depth: u32 = 0;
252:     let mut hrefs: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
253:     let mut capturing_href = false;
254:     let mut current_href = String::new();
255: 
256:     loop {
257:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
258:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
259:                 let local_name_ref = start.local_name();
260:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
261:                 if !root_seen {
262:                     if local != "calendar-multiget" {
263:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
264:                     }
265:                     root_seen = true;
266:                     depth = 1;
267:                     continue;
268:                 }
269:                 depth += 1;
270:                 if depth == 2 && local == "href" {
271:                     capturing_href = true;
272:                     current_href.clear();
273:                 }
274:             }
275:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
276:                 let local_name_ref = empty.local_name();
277:                 let local = name_to_str(local_name_ref.as_ref());
278:                 if !root_seen {
279:                     if local != "calendar-multiget" {
280:                         return Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot);
281:                     }
282:                     root_seen = true;
283:                     continue;
284:                 }
285:                 depth += 1;
286:                 if depth == 2 && local == "href" {
287:                     // Self-closing href carries no text; record it as empty.
288:                     if hrefs.len() >= MAX_MULTIGET_HREFS {
289:                         return Err(QueryError::TooManyHrefs);
290:                     }
291:                     hrefs.push(String::new());
292:                 }
293:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
294:             }
295:             Ok(Event::Text(ref text_event)) => {
296:                 if capturing_href {
297:                     current_href.push_str(text_event.unescape().unwrap_or_default().as_ref());
298:                 }
299:             }

301:                 if capturing_href {
302:                     capturing_href = false;
303:                     if hrefs.len() >= MAX_MULTIGET_HREFS {
304:                         return Err(QueryError::TooManyHrefs);
305:                     }
306:                     hrefs.push(current_href.trim().to_owned());
307:                 }
308:                 depth = depth.saturating_sub(1);
309:             }
310:             Ok(Event::Eof) => {
311:                 if depth > 0 {
312:                     return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
313:                 }
314:                 break;
315:             }
316:             Ok(_) => {}
317:             Err(_) => return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml),

331: /// Determine the report type from the body and parse it accordingly.
332: pub fn parse_calendar_report(body: &[u8]) -> Result<CalendarReport, QueryError> {
333:     if body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES {
334:         return Err(QueryError::MalformedXml);
335:     }
336:     let text = std::str::from_utf8(body).map_err(|_| QueryError::MalformedXml)?;
337:     let root = peek_root(text).ok_or(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot)?;
338:     match root.as_str() {
339:         "calendar-query" => Ok(CalendarReport::Query(parse_calendar_query(body)?)),
340:         "calendar-multiget" => Ok(CalendarReport::Multiget(parse_calendar_multiget(body)?)),
341:         _ => Err(QueryError::UnsupportedRoot),
342:     }
343: }

345: /// Read the first element name in an XML document, if any.
346: fn peek_root(text: &str) -> Option<String> {
347:     let mut reader = Reader::from_str(text);
348:     reader.config_mut().trim_text(true);
349:     let mut buf = Vec::new();
350:     loop {
351:         match reader.read_event_into(&mut buf) {
352:             Ok(Event::Start(ref start)) => {
353:                 return Some(name_to_str(start.local_name().as_ref()).to_owned());
354:             }
355:             Ok(Event::Empty(ref empty)) => {
356:                 return Some(name_to_str(empty.local_name().as_ref()).to_owned());
357:             }
358:             Ok(Event::Eof) => return None,
359:             Ok(_) => {}
360:             Err(_) => return None,
361:         }
362:         buf.clear();
363:     }
364: }

-- Migration 0013: external_feeds
-- Creates external_feeds and external_event_mapping tables.
-- Idempotent: uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS external_feeds (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    calendar_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES calendars(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    source_url_encrypted BLOB NOT NULL,
    source_url_display TEXT NOT NULL,
    refresh_interval_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (refresh_interval_seconds >= 60),
    etag TEXT,
    last_modified TEXT,
    last_attempt_at INTEGER,
    last_success_at INTEGER,
    next_refresh_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_error_code TEXT,
    consecutive_failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (consecutive_failures >= 0),
    disabled_at INTEGER,
    created_by_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS external_feeds_calendar_id_idx ON external_feeds(calendar_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS external_feeds_next_refresh_idx ON external_feeds(next_refresh_at) WHERE disabled_at IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS external_event_mapping (
    feed_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES external_feeds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    external_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
    recurrence_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    event_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    external_sequence INTEGER,
    external_modified_at INTEGER,
    content_hash BLOB,
    last_seen_sync_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (feed_id, external_uid, recurrence_id),
    UNIQUE (event_id)
);
